cliPath.description: Path to the openclaw binary used to call the gateway. Default 'openclaw' (resolved from PATH).

cooldownMs.description: Minimum time between two compactions of the same session. Default 3600000 (1h).

dryRun.description: When true, log what would be compacted but do not compact. Default false.

enabledAgents.description: Optional allowlist of agent ids this plugin acts on. When empty, all agents are covered.

fallbackModels.description: Model ids that count as fallbacks. Defaults to agents.defaults.model.fallbacks from the gateway config.

primaryModel.description: Model id of the primary model (e.g. opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash). Defaults to agents.defaults.model.primary from the gateway config.

tokenThreshold.description: Only compact when the session's input tokens exceed this. Default 100000.

description: Compacts a session automatically after a run fails over to a fallback model, so the next run starts with a small prompt instead of a bloated one.
name: Failover Compact
